sentences.en: A waterfall of sweat began to pour down my face.
sentences.zh: 汗水像瀑布一样从我的脸上流下来。

sentences.en: This is one of the prettiest waterfalls I've ever seen.
sentences.zh: 这是我见过最美的瀑布之一。

sentences.en: Zimbabwe is home to the largest waterfall in the world.
sentences.zh: 津巴布韦拥有世界上最大的瀑布。

senses.zh: 瀑布,瀑布似的东西,<美俚>（披垂的）波型长发
